claim_boundary: This contract fixes information roles, target analyzable pair counts, and planning reserve arithmetic before v2 outcomes. It does not create an official split, demonstrate statistical power, estimate formal-review completion, authorize an outcome packet, or establish model performance.

development.permitted_outcome_use: feature engineering, transformations, model-family comparison, regularization selection, and error analysis

calibration.permitted_outcome_use: probability calibration and action-threshold fitting after the development model specification is frozen

mechanism_confirmation.permitted_outcome_use: pre-specified mechanism and failure-mode confirmation only

deployment_confirmation.permitted_outcome_use: primary representative-queue proper-score, calibration, risk, coverage, time, and cost evaluation

planning_assumption_boundary: The 0.90 completion fraction is a conservative planning assumption. It is not estimated from the 72-task outcome-free interface rehearsal and is not a claim about formal-label completion.
remaining_freeze_gates: reviewer identity-separation and adjudication assignment audit
actual zero-crossing image and pair manifests
resolved_freeze_gates: formal stratification rule accepted pre-outcome on 2026-07-16 in pferi_v2_four_stage_stratified_sampling_contract_v1
